Population momentum, population ethics, and the prospects for fertility policy as climate mitigation policy
abstract: What are the prospects for using population policy as tool to reduce carbon emissions? In this paper, we review evidence from population science, in order to inform debates in population ethics that, so far, have largely taken place within the academic philosophy literature. In particular, we ask whether fertility policy is likely to have a large effect on carbon emissions, and therefore on temperature change. Our answer is no. Prospects for a policy of fertility-reduction-as-climate-mitigation are limited by population momentum, a demographic factor that limits possible variation in the size of the population, even if fertility rates change very quickly. In particular, a hypothetical policy that instantaneously changed fertility and mortality rates to replacement levels would nevertheless result in a population of over 9 billion people in 2060. We use a leading climate-economy model to project the consequence of such a hypothetical policy for climate change. As a standalone mitigation policy, such a hypothetical change in the size of the future population - much too large to be implementable by any foreseeable government program - would reduce peak temperature change only to 6.4°C, relative to 7.1°C under the most likely population path. Therefore, fertility reduction is unlikely to be an adequate core approach to climate mitigation.
abstract_zh: 利用人口政策作为减少碳排放工具的前景如何？在本文中，我们回顾人口科学的证据，以为人口伦理学中的争论提供参考，而这些争论迄今主要发生在学术哲学文献之中。具体而言，我们探讨生育政策是否可能对碳排放，进而对气温变化产生较大影响。我们的答案是否定的。以降低生育率作为气候减缓手段的前景受到人口惯性的限制，这一人口学因素即使在生育率变化非常迅速的情况下，也会限制人口规模可能发生的变化。具体而言，一项假设性政策若能将生育率和死亡率瞬间调整至更替水平，到2060年人口仍将超过90亿。我们利用一个主流的气候-经济模型，预测这一假设性政策对气候变化的影响。作为一项独立的减缓政策，这种对未来人口规模的假设性改变（其规模过大，任何可预见的政府项目都无法实施），只能将峰值气温变化降至6.4°C，而在最可能的人口路径下为7.1°C。因此，降低生育率不太可能成为气候减缓的核心方法。

title: Repugnant Conclusions
What Should We Agree on about the Repugnant Conclusion?
Assessing high-profile public messaging for sanitation behavior change: Evidence from a mobile phone survey in India
abstract: The UN Sustainable Development Goals call for the elimination of open defecation by 2030. Assessing global progress will require learning from India's sanitation efforts because of its ambitious program of high-profile behavior change messaging to tackle open defecation, and because open defecation is widespread in India. In 2014, the Prime Minister announced a policy called the Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM), which aimed to eliminate open defecation by 2019. However, the 2015-16 National Family Health Survey -4 found that about 55% of rural and 11% of urban Indian households lack a toilet or latrine. To assess the extent of public awareness of the SBM, we use a mobile phone survey to ask about people's knowledge of the existence and purpose of the SBM. We report representative estimates of awareness of the SBM among adults in Delhi (2016), Uttar Pradesh (2016), Mumbai (2016-17), Rajasthan (2016-17), Bihar (2018), Jharkhand (2018), and Maharashtra (2018). While much of the SBM's activities took place in its last two years, we find that, at the time of the survey, no more than one-third of adults in any state are aware that the SBM intends to promote toilet and latrine use. Awareness was particularly low in Uttar Pradesh, where one in eight people who defecates in the open worldwide lives. While the SBM was very active in constructing latrines, the lack of awareness we find suggests that the SBM was less successful in raising the awareness required for large-scale behavior change in promoting latrine use.
abstract_zh: 联合国可持续发展目标呼吁到2030年消除露天排便。要评估全球进展，就必须借鉴印度的卫生努力，因为印度实施了雄心勃勃的高调行为改变宣传项目以应对露天排便问题，而且露天排便在印度十分普遍。2014年，印度总理宣布了一项名为“清洁印度使命”（Swachh Bharat Mission，SBM）的政策，旨在到2019年消除露天排便。然而，2015–16年全国家庭健康调查第四轮发现，约55%的农村家庭和11%的城市家庭没有厕所或盥洗设施。为评估公众对SBM的知晓程度，我们通过手机调查询问人们是否知道SBM的存在及其目的。我们报告了德里（2016）、北方邦（2016）、孟买（2016–17）、拉贾斯坦邦（2016–17）、比哈尔邦（2018）、贾坎德邦（2018）和马哈拉施特拉邦（2018）成年人中SBM知晓率的代表性估计。尽管SBM的大部分活动发生在其最后两年，但我们发现，在调查时，任何一个邦中知道SBM旨在推动厕所使用的成年人都不超过三分之一。北方邦的知晓率尤其低，而全球每八位露天排便者中就有一位生活在该邦。尽管SBM在修建厕所方面非常活跃，但我们发现的知晓度不足表明，SBM在提高促进厕所使用所需的认知度、以实现大规模行为改变方面成效不佳。

title: Exposure to open defecation can account for the Indian enigma of child height
Persistence of solid fuel use despite increases in LPG ownership: New survey evidence from rural north India
abstract: Solid fuel use is an important contributor to air pollution and disease burden in India. We present survey evidence documenting LPG ownership and cooking fuel use in rural north India. LPG ownership has increased rapidly, substantially driven by the Ujjwala Yojana. Three-quarters of rural households in Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh now have LPG. Almost all of these households also have a stove that uses solid fuels, and among those owning both, almost three-quarters used solid fuels the day before the survey. Household economic status, relative costs of cooking fuels, gender inequality, and beliefs regarding the ease, food taste, and health impacts of cooking with solid fuels versus LPG are important contributors to high solid fuel use despite LPG ownership. Households that continue to use solid fuels continue to expose themselves and their neighbours to harmful air pollution. To realize the full health benefits of Ujjwala’s expansion in LPG ownership, attention must now be turned towards discouraging the use of solid fuels and promoting exclusive use of LPG. This is an urgent priority for research, policy, and action.
abstract_zh: 固体燃料的使用是印度空气污染和疾病负担的重要来源。我们提供了调查证据，记录了印度北部农村地区液化石油气（LPG）的拥有情况和炊事燃料的使用情况。液化石油气的拥有率迅速上升，很大程度上得益于“Ujjwala计划”（Ujjwala Yojana）的推动。比哈尔邦、中央邦、拉贾斯坦邦和北方邦目前有四分之三的农村家庭拥有液化石油气。几乎所有这些家庭也都有使用固体燃料的炉灶，而在同时拥有两者的家庭中，接近四分之三的家庭在调查前一天使用了固体燃料。家庭经济状况、各类炊事燃料的相对成本、性别不平等，以及对使用固体燃料与液化石油气在操作便利性、食物口感和健康影响方面的看法，是尽管拥有液化石油气仍大量使用固体燃料的重要原因。继续使用固体燃料的家庭，也使其自身和邻居暴露于有害空气污染之中。要充分实现“Ujjwala计划”扩大液化石油气拥有率所带来的健康效益，必须转而致力于抑制固体燃料的使用，并推动专用液化石油气。这是研究、政策与行动中一项紧迫的优先任务。

Optimal climate policy and the future of world economic development
abstract: How much should the present generations sacrifice to reduce emissions today, in order to reduce the future harms of climate change? Within climate economics, debate on this question has been focused on so-called “ethical parameters” of social time preference and inequality aversion. We show that optimal climate policy similarly importantly depends on the future of the developing world. In particular, although global poverty is falling and the economic lives of the poor are improving worldwide, leading models of climate economics may be too optimistic about two central predictions: future population growth in poor countries, and future convergence in total factor productivity (TFP). We report results of small modifications to a standard model: under plausible scenarios for high future population growth (especially in sub-Saharan Africa) and for low future TFP convergence, we find that optimal near-term carbon taxes could be substantially larger.
abstract_zh: 当代人应当为减少当前排放、从而降低未来气候变化的危害做出多大牺牲？在气候经济学中，关于这一问题的争论集中于社会时间偏好和不平等厌恶这两个所谓的“伦理参数”。我们表明，最优气候政策同样在很大程度上取决于发展中世界的未来。具体而言，尽管全球贫困正在减少，穷人的经济生活在全球范围内也在改善，但主流气候经济学模型对两个核心预测可能过于乐观：贫困国家未来的人口增长，以及未来全要素生产率（TFP）的趋同。我们报告了对标准模型进行小幅修改后的结果：在未来人口高增长（特别是在撒哈拉以南非洲）以及全要素生产率趋同较弱这两种合理情景下，我们发现最优的近期碳税可能大幅提高。

title: The Asymmetry of Population Ethics: Experimental Social Choice and Dual-Process Moral Reasoning
The association of early-life exposure to ambient PM2.5 and later-childhood height-for-age in India: an observational study
abstract: Children in India are exposed to high levels of ambient fine particulate matter (PM2.5). However, population-level evidence of associations with adverse health outcomes from within the country is limited. The aim of our study is to estimate the association of early-life exposure to ambient PM2.5 with child health outcomes (height-for-age) in India. We linked nationally-representative anthropometric data from India’s 2015–2016 Demographic and Health Survey (n = 218,152 children under five across 640 districts of India) with satellite-based PM2.5 exposure (concentration) data. We then applied fixed effects regression to assess the association between early-life ambient PM2.5 and subsequent height-for-age, analyzing whether deviations in air pollution from the seasonal average for a particular place are associated with deviations in child height from the average for that season in that place, controlling for trends over time, temperature, and birth, mother, and household characteristics. We also explored the timing of exposure and potential non-linearities in the concentration-response relationship. Children in the sample were exposed to an average of 55 μ g/m3 of PM2.5 in their birth month. After controlling for potential confounders, a 100 μg/m3 increase in PM2.5 in the month of birth was associated with a 0.05 [0.01–0.09] standard deviation reduction in child height. For an average 5 year old girl, this represents a height deficit of 0.24 [0.05–0.43] cm. We also found that exposure to PM2.5 in the last trimester in utero and in the first few months of life are significantly (p < 0.05) associated with child height deficits. We did not observe a decreasing marginal risk at high levels of exposure. India experiences some of the worst air pollution in the world. To our knowledge, this is the first study to estimate the association of early-life exposure to ambient PM2.5 on child height-for-age at the range of ambient pollution exposures observed in India. Because average exposure to ambient PM2.5 is high in India, where child height-for-age is a critical challenge in human development, our results highlight ambient air pollution as a public health policy priority.
abstract_zh: 印度儿童暴露于高水平的环境细颗粒物（PM2.5）之中。然而，关于该国人口层面此类暴露与不良健康结局之间关联的证据有限。本研究旨在估计生命早期暴露于环境PM2.5与印度儿童健康结局（身高别年龄）之间的关联。我们将印度2015–2016年人口与健康调查（DHS）中具有全国代表性的人体测量数据（涵盖640个县区的218,152名五岁以下儿童）与基于卫星的PM2.5暴露（浓度）数据相连接。随后，我们应用固定效应回归，评估生命早期的环境PM2.5与随后的身高别年龄之间的关联，分析某一地点的空气污染相对于该地季节平均值的偏离，是否与该地儿童身高相对于同季节平均值的偏离相关，同时控制时间趋势、气温以及出生、母亲和家庭特征。我们还探讨了暴露的时点以及浓度-反应关系中可能存在的非线性。样本中的儿童在出生月份平均暴露于55 μg/m³的PM2.5。在控制潜在混杂因素后，出生月份PM2.5每增加100 μg/m³，与儿童身高降低0.05（95%置信区间[0.01–0.09]）个标准差相关。对于一名平均五岁的女童而言，这相当于身高不足0.24（[0.05–0.43]）厘米。我们还发现，妊娠最后三个月子宫内的暴露以及出生后最初几个月的暴露，与儿童身高不足显著相关（p < 0.05）。在高暴露水平下，我们未观察到边际风险递减。印度是世界上空气污染最严重的国家之一。据我们所知，这是首项在印度所观察到的环境污染暴露范围内，估计生命早期暴露于环境PM2.5与身高别年龄之间关联的研究。鉴于印度的平均环境PM2.5暴露水平较高，而身高别年龄是印度人类发展面临的关键挑战，我们的结果凸显了环境空气污染作为公共卫生政策优先事项的地位。

title: The consequences of social inequality for the health and development of India's children: The case of caste, sanitation, and child height
The impact of human health co-benefits on evaluations of global climate policy
abstract:
The health co-benefits of CO
2
mitigation can provide a strong incentive for climate policy through reductions in air pollutant emissions that occur when targeting shared sources. However, reducing air pollutant emissions may also have an important co-harm, as the aerosols they form produce net cooling overall. Nevertheless, aerosol impacts have not been fully incorporated into cost-benefit modeling that estimates how much the world should optimally mitigate. Here we find that when both co-benefits and co-harms are taken fully into account, optimal climate policy results in immediate net benefits globally, overturning previous findings from cost-benefit models that omit these effects. The global health benefits from climate policy could reach trillions of dollars annually, but will importantly depend on the air quality policies that nations adopt independently of climate change. Depending on how society values better health, economically optimal levels of mitigation may be consistent with a target of 2 °C or lower.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳（CO2）减排的健康协同效益，可以通过在针对共同排放源时减少空气污染物排放，为气候政策提供强大的激励。然而，减少空气污染物排放也可能产生重要的协同危害，因为其形成的气溶胶总体上产生净冷却效应。尽管如此，气溶胶影响尚未充分纳入估算各国最优减排程度的成本效益模型之中。在此，我们发现，当同时充分考虑协同效益和协同危害时，最优气候政策将立即在全球范围内产生净收益，推翻了忽略这些效应的成本效益模型先前得出的结论。气候政策带来的全球健康收益每年可能高达数万亿美元，但这将在很大程度上取决于各国独立于气候变化而采取的空气质量政策。根据社会对更好健康的重视程度，经济上最优的减排水平可能与2°C或更低的温控目标相一致。

title: Child height in India: Facts and interpretations from the 2015-16 NFHS-4
Health externalities of India's expansion of coal plants: Evidence from a national panel of 40,000 households
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Coal power generation is expanding rapidly in India and other developing countries. In addition to consequences for climate change, present-day health externalities may also substantially increase the social cost of coal. Health consequences of air pollution have proven important in studies of developed countries, but, despite clear importance, similarly well-identified estimates are less available for developing countries, and no estimates exist for the important case of coal in India. We exploit panel data on Indian households, matched to local changes in exposure to coal plants. Increased exposure to coal plants is associated with worse respiratory health. Consistent with a causal mechanism, the effect is specific: no effect is seen on diarrhea or fever, and no effect on respiratory health is seen of new non-coal plants. Our result is not due to endogenous avoidance behavior, or to differential trends in determinants of respiratory health, either before the period studied or simultaneously.
abstract_zh: 印度及其他发展中国家的燃煤发电正在迅速扩张。除气候变化的后果外，当前的健康外部性也可能大幅提高煤炭的社会成本。空气污染的健康后果在发达国家的研究中已被证明十分重要，但尽管其重要性显而易见，发展中国家（尤其是印度的煤炭）同样具有良好识别的估计结果却较为少见，印度煤炭的情况更是尚无估计。我们利用印度家庭的面板数据，并将其与当地燃煤电厂暴露的变化相匹配。燃煤电厂暴露增加与呼吸系统健康状况恶化相关。与因果机制一致的是，这一效应具有特异性：对腹泻或发热没有影响，新建的非煤电厂对呼吸系统健康也没有影响。我们的结果既不是内生回避行为所致，也不是呼吸健康决定因素的差异化趋势所致，无论是在研究时段之前还是同期。

title: Implications of WASH Benefits trials for open defecation Sustainable Development Goal
Maximizing the Public Health Benefits from Climate Action
abstract: Environmental benefits that could be gained by successful climate change mitigation actions are usually subject to long action-reaction time lags. Furthermore, the links of mitigation efforts to major sources of climate forcing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions are often complex. Therefore, there is a risk that potentially effective mitigation strategies are discounted by policy-makers and the general public, and not given sufficient weight in economic models. In contrast, if these mitigation strategies have human health co-benefits, they are much more likely to be appreciated by policy makers and the general public. Effects are more immediate, tangible and often represent greater motivation for action. We present here the nature, scope, and policy implications of the potential human health and economic co-benefits from climate mitigation actions.
abstract_zh: 成功的气候变化减缓行动所能带来的环境效益，通常受到较长的行动—反应时滞的制约。此外，减排努力与主要温室气体（GHG）排放源之间的联系往往十分复杂。因此，存在一种风险：潜在有效的减缓策略可能被政策制定者和公众低估，并在经济模型中未获得足够权重。相反，若这些减缓策略具有人类健康方面的协同效益，则更有可能获得政策制定者和公众的认可。其效果更为直接、切实，往往也构成更大的行动动力。本文阐述了气候减缓行动所带来的人类健康和经济协同效益的性质、范围及政策含义。

title: Neighborhood sanitation and infant mortality
abstract: In this paper, we shed new light on a long-standing puzzle: In India, Muslim children are substantially more likely than Hindu children to survive to their first birthday, even though Indian Muslims have lower wealth, consumption, educational attainment, and access to state services. Contrary to the prior literature, we show that the observed mortality advantage accrues not to Muslim households themselves but rather to their neighbors, who are also likely to be Muslim. Investigating mechanisms, we provide a collage of evidence suggesting externalities due to poor sanitation are a channel linking the religious composition of neighborhoods to infant mortality.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们对一个长期存在的谜题提出了新的见解：在印度，穆斯林儿童活到一周岁的可能性显著高于印度教儿童，尽管印度穆斯林的财富、消费、教育水平以及获得国家公共服务的机会都较低。与以往文献相反，我们表明，这一死亡率优势并非来自穆斯林家庭本身，而是来自其邻居，而这些邻居很可能也是穆斯林。在考察机制时，我们提供了多方面的证据，表明较差的卫生条件所产生的外部性，是将邻里宗教构成与婴儿死亡率联系起来的渠道。

title: Open Defecation in Rural India, 2015-16: Levels and Trends in NFHS-4
Quantifying India's Climate Vulnerability
Sanitation and religion in South Asia: What accounts for differences across countries?
abstract: Exposure to open defecation has serious consequences for child mortality, health, and human capital development. South Asia has the highest rates of open defecation worldwide, and although the incidence declines as household income rises, differences across South Asian countries are not explained by differences in per capita income. The rate of open defecation in sub-national regions of Bangladesh, India and Nepal is highly correlated with the fraction of the population that identifies as Hindu, in part because certain rituals of purity and pollution discourage having latrines in close proximity to one's home. Almost all open defecation occurs in rural areas, and this paper estimates how much the rate could be reduced if rural households in regions that have a higher fraction of Hindus, where open defecation is still common, altered their behaviour to reflect that of non-Hindu households in regions that are predominantly non-Hindu, where the rate of open defecation is much lower. Using nonparametric reweighting methods, this paper projects that rural open defecation in Bangladesh, India, and Nepal could be reduced to rates of between 6 and 8 per cent, compared to the prevailing level of 65 per cent.
abstract_zh: 接触露天排便会对儿童死亡率、健康和人力资本发展产生严重后果。南亚是全球露天排便率最高的地区，尽管其发生率随家庭收入上升而下降，但南亚各国之间的差异无法由人均收入差异来解释。孟加拉国、印度和尼泊尔各次区域的露天排便率，与自认为印度教徒的人口比例高度相关，部分原因在于某些关于洁净与污秽的仪式使人们不愿在靠近住所的地方修建厕所。几乎所有露天排便都发生在农村地区。本文估计，若露天排便仍较为普遍的印度教徒比例较高地区的农村家庭，改变其行为，使之与以非印度教徒为主、露天排便率低得多的地区的非印度教家庭保持一致，那么露天排便率可以下降多少。运用非参数重加权方法，本文预测，孟加拉国、印度和尼泊尔的农村露天排便率可降至6%至8%，而目前的水平为65%。

title: Sanitation, disease externalities, and anemia: Evidence from Nepal
Heat, humidity, and infant mortality in the developing world
abstract: We study how extreme temperature exposure impacts infant survival in the developing world. Our analysis overcomes the absence of vital registration systems in many poor countries, which has been a limiting factor in the temperature-mortality literature, by extracting birth histories from household surveys. Studying 53 developing countries that span the globe, we find impacts of hot days on infant mortality that are an order of magnitude larger than estimates from rich country studies, with humidity playing an important role. The size and implied geographic distribution of harms documented here have the potential to significantly alter assessments of optimal climate policy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究极端温度暴露如何影响发展中世界的婴儿存活。许多贫穷国家缺乏生命登记系统，这一局限一直是温度与死亡率文献中的制约因素，而我们的分析通过从住户调查中提取出生史克服了这一局限。在覆盖全球的53个发展中国家的研究中，我们发现，炎热天数对婴儿死亡率的影响比富裕国家研究的估计值大一个数量级，其中湿度起着重要作用。本文记录的危害规模及其隐含的地理分布，有可能显著改变对最优气候政策的评估。

title: Health and hunger: disease, energy needs, and the Indian calorie consumption puzzle
abstract: India’s experience presents a puzzle at odds with a basic fact of household economics: amidst unprecedented economic growth, average per capita daily calorie consumption has declined in recent decades. Does an improving disease environment explain the calorie decline? A diminished burden of infectious disease could lower energy needs by increasing absorption and effective use of calories. We document a robust effect of disease exposure – measured as infant mortality and as poor sanitation – on calorie consumption. Similar effects are found using multiple datasets and empirical strategies. Disease can account for an important fraction (one‐fifth or more) of India’s calorie decline.
abstract_zh: 印度的经历呈现出一个与家庭经济学基本事实相悖的谜题：在经济空前增长的同时，人均每日卡路里摄入量近几十年来却有所下降。疾病环境的改善能否解释卡路里摄入的下降？传染病负担的减轻，可能通过提高热量吸收和有效利用而降低能量需求。我们以婴儿死亡率和卫生条件较差来衡量疾病暴露，记录了其对卡路里摄入量的稳健影响。使用多个数据集和多种实证策略均得到了类似结果。疾病可以解释印度卡路里下降中相当大的部分（五分之一或更多）。

title: Impact of population growth and population ethics on climate change mitigation policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: We investigate how future population growth is relevant to climate change policy. The answer depends importantly on ethical questions about whether our ultimate goal should be to increase the number of people who are happy or rather to increase the average level of people’s happiness. We calculate the best (optimal) emissions reduction pathway given each of these two different goals that society might have and calculate how much cheaper it would be to avoid dangerous interference with the climate given a smaller rather than a larger population. We also show that whether it is ultimately better to have a smaller population in response to climate change depends on which of these two goals society chooses.
abstract_zh: 本文研究未来人口增长与气候变化政策之间的关系。答案在很大程度上取决于伦理问题：社会的最终目标应当是增加幸福人口的数量，还是提高人们的平均幸福水平。针对社会可能持有的这两种不同目标，我们分别计算了最优的减排路径，并测算了在较小而非较大的人口规模下，避免危险的气候干扰将便宜多少。我们还表明，面对气候变化，是否最终应当通过缩小人口规模来应对，取决于社会选择了这两种目标中的哪一种。

title: Making people happy or making happy people?: Questionnaire-experimental studies of population ethics and policy
Optimal population with exhaustible resource constraints
Place and child health: The interaction of population density and sanitation behavior in developing countries
abstract: A long literature in demography has debated the importance of place for health, especially children’s health. In this study, we assess whether the importance of dense settlement for infant mortality and child height is moderated by exposure to local sanitation behavior. Is open defecation (i.e., without a toilet or latrine) worse for infant mortality and child height where population density is greater? Is poor sanitation is an important mechanism by which population density influences child health outcomes? We present two complementary analyses using newly assembled data sets, which represent two points in a trade-off between external and internal validity. First, we concentrate on external validity by studying infant mortality and child height in a large, international child-level data set of 172 Demographic and Health Surveys, matched to census population density data for 1,800 subnational regions. Second, we concentrate on internal validity by studying child height in Bangladeshi districts, using a new data set constructed with GIS techniques that allows us to control for fixed effects at a high level of geographic resolution. We find a statistically robust and quantitatively comparable interaction between sanitation and population density with both approaches: open defecation externalities are more important for child health outcomes where people live more closely together.
abstract_zh: 人口学领域的大量文献一直在争论地点对健康的重要性，尤其是对儿童健康的重要性。在本研究中，我们评估了密集聚居对婴儿死亡率和儿童身高的影响，是否会受到当地卫生行为的调节。在人口密度更高的地方，露天排便（即没有厕所或简易厕所）对婴儿死亡率和儿童身高是否更为不利？糟糕的卫生条件是否是人口密度影响儿童健康结果的一个重要机制？我们利用新组建的数据集开展了两项互补的分析，这两项分析分别代表了外部有效性与内部有效性之间权衡的两端。第一，我们侧重外部有效性，利用一个大型国际儿童层面数据集研究婴儿死亡率和儿童身高，该数据集包含172项人口与健康调查（Demographic and Health Surveys），并与1,800个次国家级地区的人口普查人口密度数据相匹配。第二，我们侧重内部有效性，利用孟加拉国各县的数据研究儿童身高，该数据集借助GIS技术构建，使我们能够在较高的地理分辨率下控制固定效应。两种方法均得到了统计上稳健、且数量上可比的卫生条件与人口密度交互项结果：在人们居住更为密集的地方，露天排便的外部性对儿童健康结果的影响更为重要。

title: Switching to sanitation: Understanding latrine adoption in a representative panel of rural Indian households
Understanding open defecation in rural India: Untouchability, pollution, and latrine pits
abstract: India has far higher open defecation rates than other developing regions where people are poorer, literacy rates are lower, and water is relatively more scarce. In practice, government programmes in rural India have paid little attention in understanding why so many rural Indians defecate in the open rather than use affordable pit latrines. Drawing on new data, a study points out that widespread open defecation in rural India is on account of beliefs, values, and norms about purity, pollution, caste, and untouchability that cause people to reject affordable latrines. Future rural sanitation programmes must address villagers' ideas about pollution, pit-emptying, and untouchability, and should do so in ways that accelerate progress towards social equality for Dalits rather than delay it.
abstract_zh: 印度的露天排便率远高于其他发展中地区，而那些地区的人口更为贫穷、识字率更低，水资源也相对更为稀缺。实践中，印度农村的政府计划很少关注这样一个问题：为什么如此多的农村印度人宁愿露天排便，而不使用价格可承受的坑式厕所。一项利用新数据的研究指出，印度农村普遍存在露天排便，是因为关于洁净、污染、种姓和不可接触制的信念、价值观与规范，使人们拒绝使用价格可承受的厕所。未来的农村卫生计划必须正视村民关于污染、坑式厕所清掏以及不可接触制的观念，并且应当以推动达利特（Dalit）群体实现社会平等的方式加以应对，而不是延缓这一进程。

title: Where India Goes: Abandoned Toilets, Stunted Development, and the Costs of Caste
An experiment with air purifiers in Delhi during winter 2015-2016
Can collective action strategies motivate behavior change to reduce open defecation in rural India?
Caste and life satisfaction in rural north India
Disease externalities and net nutrition: Evidence from changes in sanitation and child height in Cambodia, 2005-2010
Effects of Early-Life Exposure to Rural Sanitation on Childhood Cognitive Skills: Evidence from India's Total Sanitation Campaign
abstract: Early life health and net nutrition shape childhood and adult cognitive skills and human capital. In poor countries -- and especially in South Asia -- widespread open defecation without making use of a toilet or latrine is an important source of childhood disease. This paper studies the effects on childhood cognitive achievement of early life exposure to India's Total Sanitation Campaign, a large government program that encouraged local governments to build and promote use of inexpensive pit latrines. In the early years of the program studied here, the TSC caused six-year-olds exposed to it in their first year of life to be more likely to recognize letters and simple numbers. The results suggest both that open defecation is an important threat to the human capital of the Indian labor force, and that a program feasible to low capacity governments in developing countries could improve average cognitive skills.
abstract_zh: 早期的健康状况与营养净摄入会塑造儿童和成人的认知能力与人力资本。在贫穷国家——尤其是在南亚——普遍存在的露天排便（即不使用厕所或简易厕所），是儿童疾病的一个重要来源。本文研究了童年早期接触印度“全面卫生运动”（Total Sanitation Campaign，TSC）对儿童认知成就的影响。该运动是一项大型政府计划，鼓励地方政府修建并推广使用价格低廉的坑式厕所。在本文所研究的该计划早期阶段，TSC使得在出生第一年接触到该运动的六岁儿童更有可能认识字母和简单数字。结果表明，一方面，露天排便是印度劳动力人力资本的重要威胁；另一方面，一项对治理能力较弱的发展中国家政府而言可行的计划，能够提高平均认知技能。

title: Improving sanitation is a policy priority for children's human capital in rural India: Lessons from recent literature and the IHDS
venue: Undernutrition and Public Policy in India (book chapter)
abstract: The first part of this chapter reviews evidence from the literature of a large effect of open defecation on child height that can account for important international differences. It also documented negative externalities of open defecation: neighbours&s; faecal pathogens are bad for your children&s;s health even if you dispose of your faeces safely. The second part of the chapter presents new empirical results using the rural part of the India Human Development Survey (IHDS). It presents evidence on a quantitatively robust association between sanitation and child well-being especially net nutritional outcomes from the rural sample of the 2005 IHDS. The chapter joins a quickly growing literature documenting the importance of sanitation and exposure to open defecation externalities for child well-being and human capital accumulation. Other papers have emphasized identification strategies for causal inference; it also contributes analysis of a particularly noteworthy cross-sectional data set that combines economic, social, anthropometric and cognitive achievement data.
abstract_zh: 本章第一部分回顾了文献中的证据：露天排便对儿童身高有很大影响，这一影响可以解释重要的国际差异。文献还记载了露天排便的负外部性：即使你安全处理了自己的粪便，邻居的粪便病原体也会损害你孩子的健康。本章第二部分利用2005年印度人类发展调查（IHDS）农村部分的新实证结果，给出了卫生设施与儿童福祉之间稳健关联的证据，尤其是在2005年农村样本中，卫生设施与净营养状况结果之间的关联。本章加入了一个快速增长的文献群，这些文献记录了卫生设施以及暴露于露天排便外部性对儿童福祉和人力资本积累的重要性。其他论文强调了因果推断的识别策略；本章则为一个特别值得关注的截面数据集的分析作出贡献，该数据集整合了经济、社会、人体测量及认知能力成就数据。

title: Purity, pollution, and untouchability: Challenges affecting the adoption, use, and sustainability of sanitation programmes in rural India
Village sanitation and child health: Effects and external validity in a randomized field experiment in rural India
abstract: Over a billion people worldwide defecate in the open, with important consequences for early-life health and human capital accumulation in developing countries. We report a cluster randomized controlled trial of a village sanitation intervention conducted in rural Maharashtra, India designed to identify an effect of village sanitation on average child height, an outcome of increasing importance to economists. We find an effect of approximately 0.3 height-for-age standard deviations, which is consistent with observations and hypotheses in economic and health literatures. We further exploit details of the planning and implementation of the experiment to study treatment heterogeneity and external validity.
abstract_zh: 全球有十多亿人露天排便，这对发展中国家的早期健康和人力资本积累具有重要影响。我们报告了一项在印度马哈拉施特拉邦农村开展的整群随机对照试验，该试验针对村庄卫生干预，旨在识别村庄卫生对儿童平均身高的影响，而身高是经济学家日益关注的结果变量。我们发现效应约为0.3个年龄别身高标准差，这与经济学和健康文献中的观察结果和假说相一致。我们进一步利用实验规划与实施过程中的细节，研究处理效应的异质性和外部有效性。

title: What doesn't kill you makes you poorer: Effects of the early-life disease environment on adult wages in India

title: Short-Term Labor Migration from Rural North India: Evidence from New Survey Data
Are children in West Bengal shorter than children in Bangladesh?
Decision Costs and Price Sensitivity: Field Experimental Evidence from India
Having a son promotes clean cooking fuel use in urban India
abstract: Urban Indian households with a male first child are approximately 2 percentage points more likely to use clean cooking fuel than comparable households with a female first child. Given Indian son preference, there are at least two mechanisms by which child sex could affect fuel choice: by improving the intrahousehold status of women, who bear more of the costs of traditional fuels, or by presenting an opportunity to invest in children’s health, in the context of a preference for healthier boys. If child sex is not selected for by biased abortion or other processes, then the sex of a first child has an exogenous causal effect on household fuel choice. We show that the association between fuel choice and child sex is not driven by terminated pregnancies or by household wealth or family size. Among a range of outcomes we study, the effect of child sex is unique to fuel choice; our finding that there is no effect on other assets indicates that it is unlikely that the result is confounded by real or subjectively anticipated wealth. In addition to the National Family Health Survey NFHS-3, the main data source studied, we approximately replicate the result using the NFHS-2 and the District Level Health and Facilities Survey DLHS-3. Finally, we show evidence for a “first-stage” effect of having a first son on women’s social status: such women have a greater body mass index, on average.
abstract_zh: 首胎为男孩的城市印度家庭，使用清洁烹饪燃料的概率比首胎为女孩的可比家庭高约2个百分点。鉴于印度存在重男轻女的偏好，孩子性别可以通过至少两种机制影响燃料选择：一是改善女性在家庭内部的地位，因为女性承担了更多使用传统燃料的成本；二是提供投资于儿童健康的机会，即在偏好更健康男孩的背景下，家庭借此增加对男孩的健康投入。若孩子性别并非由选择性堕胎或其他过程所决定，那么首胎性别便对家庭燃料选择具有外生的因果效应。我们表明，燃料选择与孩子性别之间的关联，并非由终止妊娠、家庭财富或家庭规模所驱动。在我们研究的一系列结果中，孩子性别的效应仅体现在燃料选择上；其对其他资产没有影响，这表明该结果不太可能受到实际或主观预期财富的混淆。除了主要使用的数据来源——全国家庭健康调查第三期（NFHS-3）之外，我们还利用NFHS-2和地区层面健康与设施调查第三期（DLHS-3）近似复现了这一结果。最后，我们表明，首胎为男孩对女性社会地位存在“第一阶段”效应：此类女性平均而言具有更高的身体质量指数。

title: Revealed preference for open defecation: Evidence from a new survey in rural north India
Caste, 'cleanliness', and cash: Effects of caste-based political reservations in Rajasthan on a sanitation prize
abstract: Even compared with neighbouring countries, latrine use is especially uncommon in India. How might caste – historically associated with sanitation inequality – interact with government sanitation policy? Using data from Rajasthan state, we investigate the effect of caste-based reservations for village chairmen elected in 2005 on the likelihood of winning the government’s Clean Village Prize by mid 2012. This prize is a large cash award for villages in which open defecation has been eliminated; thus it is intended to be a prize for both latrine construction and use. Villages randomly assigned to a Scheduled (low-ranking) Caste chairman are less likely to win the prize.
abstract_zh: 即使与邻国相比，印度的厕所使用率也尤其偏低。种姓——历史上与卫生不平等相关联——如何与政府卫生政策相互作用？利用拉贾斯坦邦的数据，我们考察了2005年基于种姓的村长保留名额，对村庄在2012年年中之前赢得政府“清洁村庄奖”（Clean Village Prize）可能性的影响。该奖项为已消除露天排便的村庄提供高额现金奖励，因此它旨在同时奖励厕所建设和厕所使用。被随机分配到表列种姓（低种姓）村长的村庄，赢得该奖项的可能性较低。
